seoTitle: VLSM Subnet Calculator: Split a Network by Host Needs
metaDescription: Split a network into subnets of different sizes by the number of hosts each needs, with network, mask, first and last host and broadcast for each.
intro: Plan an IPv4 address layout that wastes as few addresses as possible.
why:
Enter the parent network in CIDR and the subnets you need as "name hosts". The calculator sorts requests from largest to smallest, assigns each the smallest block that fits (hosts plus network and broadcast addresses), keeps blocks aligned, and prints network, mask, host range, broadcast and usable count. Results were compared with Python's ipaddress module.

Leave room for growth by requesting more hosts than today, and note that /31 point-to-point links (RFC 3021) are not used here.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: List required subnets, one per line.
Check how much space is left.
